activities.name: RequestOrRegister
activities.whenToUse: Use with Plan.Path pointing to the desired mapped session location. Session_ST first resolves that path; when no Result is found it writes ItemSignal.GetJacket() there and returns the jacket. This operation can mutate the mapped adapter's session dictionary.
activities.description: Return an existing session or register a new one.

properties.description: Name the session operation for diagnostics.
properties.whenToUse: Name the session operation for its source Signal and diagnostics. It is not the path used to find or register the session.

properties.description: Locate an existing session or register the item jacket at that location.
properties.whenToUse: Supply the mapped-adapter path to resolve an existing session. If that lookup has no Result, the provider registers the current ItemSignal jacket at this path and returns it.

result.description: When existing session lookup or item-jacket registration; existing session found (Result presence conditional).
When existing session lookup or item-jacket registration; new session branch (Result presence conditional).

resultNotes: Session_ST: Mapped GetResult($true) recursively unwraps returned Signal; empty/null jacket may yield no public Result. Failure path drops any helper result
